test_gil_scoped_callback_py_obj: test that a Python object callback works correctly with GIL scoping in pybind11
test_gil_scoped_cross_module_gil: test that the GIL can be acquired and released across modules without segfaults
test_gil_scoped_release_acquire: test that releasing and re-acquiring the GIL returns the expected hex value
test_gil_scoped_multi_thread_deadlock: test that running GIL operations in multiple threads does not cause deadlocks
test_gil_scoped_multi_process_deadlock: test that running GIL operations in separate processes does not cause deadlocks
